content.value_statement: Teams often know competitors rank for useful topics, but they lack a clear content plan. This skill compares coverage, scores gaps, and turns findings into a prioritized editorial backlog.
actual_capabilities: Compares your domain against competitor domains to find missing topics, keywords, and content formats.
Groups opportunities into Quick Wins, Strategic Builds, and Long-term priorities.
Evaluates SEO gaps, GEO or AI-answer gaps, funnel gaps, and content format gaps.
Labels evidence as Measured, User-provided, Estimated, or N/A to avoid unsupported claims.
Produces an editorial calendar, success metrics, and a handoff for content production.
limitations: Needs your domain or content inventory plus one or more competitor domains.
Does not replace raw keyword demand discovery when no competitors are known.
Uses estimates when SEO, analytics, or search console tools are unavailable.
Cannot guarantee rankings, traffic, conversions, or AI citations after publication.

use_cases.title: Plan a Content Backlog
use_cases.description: Turn competitor coverage differences into a prioritized list of articles, pages, tools, and templates.

use_cases.title: Support SEO Strategy
use_cases.description: Identify keyword and topic gaps that explain why competitors rank for more search demand.

use_cases.title: Prepare GEO Coverage
use_cases.description: Find missing definitions, comparisons, and evidence that can help AI systems cite your brand.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Competitor Gap
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with your site and one competitor.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find content gaps between my site [your domain] and [competitor domain]. Focus on topics that can drive qualified traffic.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Competitor Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my site [your domain] with [competitor 1], [competitor 2], and [competitor 3]. Group gaps into Quick Wins, Strategic Builds, and Long-term priorities.

prompt_templates.title: Format And Funnel Gaps
prompt_templates.scenario: Find missing content types and journey stages.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze our content gaps for [topic or product]. Compare guides, comparisons, case studies, tools, templates, and funnel stages against [competitors].

prompt_templates.title: Advanced GEO Backlog
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a combined SEO and AI-answer roadmap.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a content gap analysis for [domain] versus [competitors]. Include keyword gaps, topic clusters, GEO citation gaps, evidence labels, and a four-week editorial calendar.

output_examples.input: Find gaps between our project management blog and two competitors.
output: Top gap: comparison pages for buyer-intent queries that competitors cover and your site does not.
Quick win: publish a project management templates hub supported by three related how-to articles.
Evidence label: Estimated, because no search console or SEO export was provided.

output_examples.input: Audit our GEO readiness for customer support software topics.
output: Missing assets: concise definitions, pricing comparison pages, and proof-backed implementation guides.
Priority: build answer-ready pages for high-intent support automation questions.
Success metrics: AI citations, assisted conversions, and ranking movement for target terms.

output_examples.input: Create a content calendar from competitor keyword gaps.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a ranked backlog with owners, target publish weeks, dependencies, and measurement checkpoints.

best_practices: Provide your domain, closest competitors, target audience, and business goals before analysis starts.
Attach SEO exports, analytics data, or content inventories when available.
Review Quick Wins first, then approve Strategic Builds that need design, data, or subject matter support.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill when you only need raw keyword discovery with no competitor context.
Do not treat estimated traffic or volume as measured data.
Do not publish every gap without checking business relevance, effort, and conversion intent.

faq.question: What inputs does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs your domain or content list, competitor domains, topic focus, audience, and business goals.

faq.question: Can it work without SEO tools?
faq.answer: Yes. It can proceed with user-provided data and estimates, but it labels uncertain metrics clearly.

faq.question: How is this different from keyword research?
faq.answer: Keyword research finds demand. This skill compares your coverage against competitors and turns gaps into content actions.

faq.question: Does it include AI search or GEO gaps?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks missing definitions, Q&A, comparisons, evidence, and structures that can support AI citations.

faq.question: What does the final output include?
faq.answer: It includes a summary, prioritized gaps, evidence labels, a content calendar, and success metrics.

faq.question: Can it guarantee more traffic?
faq.answer: No. It prioritizes opportunities, but rankings and traffic depend on execution, authority, competition, and search changes.
